about_the_game:
Become the new manager of a small, rundown "maid cafe" in Maid Cafe Simulator!

In a world drained of emotions by digital overload, unique furry maids with their own secrets and personalities await you. Revive the struggling cafe with these maids who trust and rely on you, and take on the fierce competition to claim the maid cafe industry's highest honor: the "Maid-chelin 3 Stars"!

Main Characters

Puppy, White Tiger, Arctic Fox, Goat, Raccoon Maids – each with their own unique charm!

Game Features

  • Manage

Enjoy managing ingredients, developing menus, serving customers, and uncovering the maids' secrets through engaging interactions.

  • Expand

Grow your cafe with new facilities and spaces to welcome more customers.

  • Fight

Stand up against difficult customers and rival cafes to protect your cafe and maids.

  • Bond

Build trust and cooperate with your maids to work toward shared dreams.

  • Heartwarming Maid Story

Experience a story of dedication, bonds, laughter, and tears with furry maids who trust only you. Cute and funny, yet deeply moving moments await.

  • Charming Maid Characters:

From a puppy maid who charges forward when hungry, to a diligent but explosive white tiger, to a haughty yet clumsy arctic fox – adorable characters blending moe and furry traits!

In Maid Cafe Simulator, rediscover lost emotions with lovable maids and achieve your dreams! Can you fulfill your dreams with these special maids by your side?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600x
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2070 / AMD 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

Manage the cafe, create menus, and charm your customers. Aim for the coveted "Maid-chelin 3 Stars" that everyone dreams of!
